DossierField.description:
One field of a provider dossier. ``value`` is the single value (a scalar, one typed figure) or the usable values
joined with `` | `` (a list field); it is null, with a ``null_reason``, when no item states the field or when usable
values conflict. ``evidence`` is the WEAKEST label among the values in ``value``. ``values`` keeps every value.
DossierField.title: DossierField

Dropped.description: Why extracted items did not become items. Every drop has a counted reason; nothing is lost silently (R26).
Dropped.title: Dropped

RunInfo.description: Volatile values: excluded from the content hash.
RunInfo.title: RunInfo

Slice.description:
Every main-store item of the lane (ordered by code, the model's order first), split into chunks of at most
``chunk_items``; the digest is an index and sits outside ``store_tokens``.
Slice.title: Slice

TypedValue.description:
A figure the page states, in parts. Every part is optional and only filled when the quote states it; code checks
the amount and the currency against the quote (``domain/typed.py``). ``amount`` is a decimal STRING, never a float.
TypedValue.title: TypedValue

data__platform_constraint.description: One platform or toolchain rule for one capability (push, background location, in-app payments ...).
data__platform_constraint.title: PlatformConstraintData

data__provider_fact.description: ONE fact about a provider with ONE quote (D-159): the dossier of a provider is assembled by code from these.
data__provider_fact.title: ProviderFactData

provider_fact__TypedValue.description:
A figure the page states, in parts. Every part is optional and only filled when the quote states it; code checks
the amount and the currency against the quote (``domain/typed.py``). ``amount`` is a decimal STRING, never a float.
provider_fact__TypedValue.title: TypedValue

input_quality.description: How far the Brief could be trusted. Keys include `input_binding` (verified | unverified_no_baseline | unverified_hash_mismatch: whether the export's own approval seal could be checked), `compass_format` (the export's format version, or null), `plan_source`, `requests`, `failures` and `flags`. An unverified Brief is researched, never refused; this says so.
input_quality.title: Input Quality
